desc: Prove that the current mapping from initial rating to current rating remains nondecreasing, so each contest affects one contiguous initial-rating interval.
Implement a lazy segment tree supporting range addition, threshold lower-bound search, and point queries.
Process each contest using searches for the first current value at least \(L_i\) and \(R_i+1\).
Handle domain boundaries and confirm that ratings exceeding \(500000\) are represented correctly.
Validate edge cases and state \(O((N+Q)\log 500000)\) time and \(O(500000)\) memory.
